title: Southern Retreat Near Downtown + Free Parking
description:
Welcome to your Southern retreat in the heart of Berry Hill! This stylish 2BR/2.5BA townhome is minutes drive from Downtown Nashville and 10-minute walk to Geodis Park, with walkable breweries, coffee shops, and local favorites nearby. Enjoy 2 free parking spaces, fast WiFi, dedicated desk area, a fully equipped kitchen, in-unit laundry, and a cozy, thoughtfully designed space perfect for concert weekends, soccer matches, girls’ trips, or relaxing getaway. We can't wait to host you in Nashville!

The space
Open ground floor has a fully equipped kitchen connected to the dining area, open living area with large sectional (can be used for additional sleeping area), dedicated desk area, washer and dryer in unit, and a half bathroom.

Upstairs you'll find 2 furnished bedrooms. Bed room 1 has one queen bed and an attached full bathroom. Bedroom 2 has a double bed with 1 full bath next to it.

Guest access
Please note that this is an owner-occupied home that is occasionally shared with guests while the owner is away. To help keep personal belongings out of your way and secure, one bedroom, the owner’s closet, and a few storage cabinets are locked and unavailable to guests. Thank you for your understanding and for treating the space with care and respect during your stay.
